title: ZECsy reports its first annual-program milestone
text:
OPENZCASH
OPERATIONS
GRANT DELIVERY
19
ZECsy reports its first annual-program milestone
Grantee delivery report · Published September 30 · Self-reported outcomes

acceptance.

A proposed Amsterdam budget reallocation needs follow-up.

title: NU7 scope converges after September polling
text:
OPENZCASH
OPERATIONS
GOVERNANCE
28
NU7 scope converges after September polling
ZCAP and Coinholders are distinct constituencies
ZCAP: 135 of 198
The advisory panel recorded 68% participation. Each question
allowed an independent abstention.
Preserve halvings
The agreed NSM variant retains halvings; recycling is
scheduled to begin in February 2031.
25-second block spacing
The published scope includes ZIP 218, disabling V4
transactions and NSM integration.
No activation claim
October 6 testnet and November 5 mainnet are planned
dates. The final mainnet decision is scheduled for October
20.

title: Adoption and tooling extend beyond the node
text:
OPENZCASH
OPERATIONS
INFRASTRUCTURE
29
Adoption and tooling extend beyond the node
September recap cross-checked against original announcements
Gemini live / ViaBTC testing
Gemini announced deployment on Sep 29. ViaBTC began
evaluation on Sep 21; production adoption was not
confirmed.
Thus Spoke Zakura
Announced Sep 21: a developer environment with a local
chain, wallet, explorer and faucet for testing.
Valar voting stack
Vizor and ZODL integrated the stack. Zakura reports
sub-minute mobile voting after Common, PIR and wallet
changes.
NU7 staging dashboard
Zakura published a live staging view and completed its NU7
implementation. Official Testnet activation was still ahead.

title: Wallet progress spans the whole release cycle
text:
OPENZCASH
OPERATIONS
WALLETS
30
Wallet progress spans the whole release cycle
September release notes · Stable and preview tracks remain distinct
ZODL / Android
3.11 adds themes; 3.13 expands Swap and CrossPay assets;
3.14 speeds larger polls; 3.15 adds viewing-key export.
Zingo / mobile and desktop
Mobile 2.0.24 is stable. Desktop 2.0.26 remains a preview
with experimental SwapKit, ZNS contacts and payment
requests.
Vizor / 0.0.54 to 0.0.58
Explorer selection, vote progress, gift cards, payment
requests and hardware signing improve across stable
releases.
Zkool / 6.29 to 6.31
FROST and migration fixes precede official Ledger
integration, voting navigation and Arti transport.

text:
